messages.subject: For R mentors having Melange trouble
parts:
If you are a mentor for a proposed R GSoC project this year, and you are
not already approved as a mentor on Melange, please send me your Melange
username/link_id.

You can find your username/link_id by looking at the top of the main
content panel on all melange pages (like your profile or your
dashboard), you should see a line something like this:

You are logged in as bgpbra...@gmail.com [username: braverock].

If you send me your melange username/link_id and a quick note about the
project you plan to mentor, I can initiate the connection from the
administrative end.

Regards,

Brian

--
Brian G. Peterson
http://braverock.com/brian/

IM: bgpbraverock
